English.Char_Desc_250: JET Game is a free arcade shooter for Windows. Steer your jet with the keyboard, fire at the enemies coming at you and build up your score. It is a tiny 75 KB download with no installer: unzip and run.
English.Char_Desc_450: JET Game is a free arcade shooter for Windows from Transys. Steer your jet with the keyboard, fire at the enemies coming at you and build up your score. The graphics are simple and the game starts instantly. It is a tiny 75 KB download with no installer: unzip the archive and run JET GAME.exe. Requires Windows 10 or 11 with the Microsoft .NET 8 Desktop Runtime.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
JET Game is a free arcade shooter for Windows from Transys. Steer your jet with the keyboard, fire at the enemies coming at you and build up your score, which is shown on screen as you play. The graphics are simple and the game starts instantly, so it suits a quick break.
The game is a tiny 75 KB download with no installer: unzip the archive and run JET GAME.exe. It requires Windows 10 or 11 with the Microsoft .NET 8 Desktop Runtime, a free download from Microsoft.
JET Game is freeware. There is nothing to buy, no time limit and no registration.
